title: Hang a hotel hanger back on its loose anti-theft ring, its ball top in the ring's small cup
instruction: Hang the hotel hanger lying on the shoe box back on the empty security ring on the closet rod, with its ball top resting in the ring's cup. The ring is loose: it slides along the rod and turns on it at a touch. Leave the hanger hanging free and square to the rod like the hanger beside it, the ring where it was, and take both hands away.
context: Most US hotel rooms hang hook-less anti-theft hangers: a chrome ball on a short pin that sits in the cup of a steel ring left on the closet rod (the maker: "an anti-theft ball-top that secures into a closed-loop closet rod", nahanco.com). Guests hang their clothes on them, and housekeepers put every hanger back on its ring when they make up a room; a common room inspection checklist counts "Cloth Hangers (8 Nos.)" per standard room (setupmyhotel.com). 420,800 maids and housekeeping cleaners work in US accommodation (BLS Industry at a Glance, NAICS 721, 2025, opened 2026-11-19), and 70% of the 172 million US travelers in 2024 stayed in a hotel (Phocuswright, 2025). The hard part is physical: the 12 g ring hangs turned at a random angle and slides or turns at a touch, and the 7 mm ball only enters its cup from the side, over a 2 mm lip, with its pin in a 2.8 mm slot. A careful hand can do it alone; a second hand may hold the ring.
setup: Millimetres. x forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the robot's left, z up from the table top. Both arms at their ready pose, grippers open. (1) Closet rod: a 33 mm (1-5/16 in) round wooden closet rod, 800 long, along y at x 400, its axis 360 above the table, held at its ends in two 18 mm plywood uprights (180 deep) at y +-400 to +-418, each on a 220 x 78 x 18 plywood foot; the frame is clamped to the table. (2) Two security rings, NAHANCO HHSRA100 A-Ring for ball top hangers, chrome-plated steel. Published (maker's page and drawing, https://www.nahanco.com/a-ring-for-ball-top-hangers.html): 1-1/2 in (38.1) opening, 1-7/8 in (47.6) wide, 2-1/4 in (57.2) high. Read from the maker's photos, scaled by those sizes: 1.5 mm plate, 4.7 mm band, a 21.4 mm bottom tab bent out 90 degrees into a cup 9 deep with a 2.8 mm slot open at its outer edge. Set, not readable: the cup's outer edge turned up 2 mm (the lip), the slot mouth's corners rounded 1 mm, mass 12 g. Each ring hangs on the rod by its opening: it slides along the rod, swings about it and turns up to about 30 degrees about the vertical, and stays where it is left. Cups face +y. Ring A at y -260; ring B at y -20 plus a seeded shift of up to +-40, turned 8 to 22 degrees either way about the vertical. A tape on the rod marks both rings' start places. (3) Two hangers, NAHANCO 60217BEC Anti-Theft Ball Top Wooden Suit Hotel Hanger, black wood, chrome ball top. Published (https://www.nahanco.com/men-s-flat-suit-ball-top-black-wood-hanger.html): 17-1/2 in (445) long, 29 lb per carton of 100 (0.13 kg each used). Read from the maker's photos: ball about 7, pin about 1.8 thick and 52 from ball to wood, wood 163 from the hump's top to the pant bar's underside, hump 56 wide at the top and 90 where the shoulders leave it. Set: wood 12.7 (1/2 in, the maker's figure for its flat wooden hangers). Hanger A hangs from ring A's cup, shoulders square to the rod. Hanger B lies flat on the shoe box's lid, ball top toward -y, its hump sticking out 65 past the box's -y edge (ball 120 from the edge); ball at (310, 40, 127) plus a seeded shift of up to +-10 in x and +-20 in y, hanger and box turned together up to +-10 degrees about the vertical. (4) Shoe box: a closed cardboard men's shoe box with its shoes, 330 x 180 x 120, 1.2 kg, long side along x, lid 35 deep. The framework turns --seed N into an episode seed, so seed 0 is not the reference layout; the README lists the layouts of seeds 0 to 2.
scoring: Read after the trial with a ruler and photos: a side photo of ring B (ruler in frame) 2 s before the end and one at the end, and a top photo at the end. 0 unless all hold: hanger B's ball rests in ring B's cup (side photo: the ball sits on the cup between the ring's plate and the lip, within 3 mm of the slot's centre line and within 2.5 mm of the seated height); hanger B hangs free, its lowest point at least 20 mm above the table; no finger within 30 mm of hanger B or ring B in the last 2 s (both side photos and the video between them); and hanger B's ball moved less than 2 mm between the two side photos. Then 0.6; +0.2 if hanger B's shoulders are within 15 degrees of square to the rod (top photo); +0.1 if ring B is within 15 mm of its start mark on the rod; +0.1 if hanger A still sits in ring A's cup and ring A is within 15 mm of its mark. 1.0 at most. No bonus counts before the ball is seated. Outcomes: untouched start 0 (hanger B on the box); a hanger held in the cup by a gripper 0 (fingers within 30 mm); hanger B dropped, hooked over the rod, lying on the ring's band, balanced on the lip or wedged between ring and rod 0 (not seated); seated but swinging 0 until it hangs still; seated with the ring pushed along the rod 0.6 to 0.9; seated without holding the ring scores like any other seat (the score judges only the end state).
reset_notes: Lift hanger B out of ring B's cup and lay it flat on the shoe box's lid at the trial's start position. Slide ring B to its start mark on the rod and turn it to the trial's angle. Check that hanger A sits in ring A's cup at its mark. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid bodies at real size and mass. Each ring rides the rod on a slider and a ball joint; contact with the rod stops its turn at about 30 degrees, as a 38 mm opening on a 33 mm rod does. The ball seats in the cup by contact only. Simplified: the cup's lip and slot-mouth rounding are set, not measured; the ring hangs 1.5 mm below the rod's axis; the ball's rub in the cup is modelled as rotation damping on the hanger (0.6 per second), not friction; the shoe box is one rigid block.
scores: Dream-1 run (seed 0, 800 steps): 0.0, it never picked up the hanger. Scripted demo, reads object poses from the simulator and moves the parts only through the grippers, by contact: 1.0 on seeds 0, 1 and 2 (demo video: seed 0).
